tools.name: generate_favicon
tools.description: Generates the complete modern favicon set (favicon.ico, icon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png, PWA icons, manifest.webmanifest, favicon-setup.md with the install snippet) from an SVG, an emoji, or short text. Returns a download URL for favicon.zip plus the HTML head snippet to paste. Files follow current b

tools.name: get_html_snippet
tools.description: Returns the modern minimal <head> snippet for favicons, plus placement guidance. Use when the favicon files already exist and only the HTML wiring is needed.

tools.name: check_favicon
tools.description: Fetches a URL, probes every icon it declares (root favicon.ico, SVG icon, apple-touch-icon, web manifest), and grades the setup against the modern set. Follow up with generate_favicon to fix what is missing.
